Package com.egradx.auth.web

Class EgradxMyProfileController

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.web.EgradxMyProfileController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/egradx/auth/my/profile") @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") public class EgradxMyProfileController extends Object
The signed-in person's own profile — the "My profile" and "Settings" screens. Needs nothing but being signed in: everyone may see and edit their own.

Contacts and preferences are those that apply everywhere plus those scoped to the organization the session is in. A person adding their own address cannot mark it verified; they confirm a code sent to it.
